findings.current: Body structure, Bumpers, Steering column, Seats, Mirrors, Wheels
findings.proposed: Engine, Transmission, Body structure (fenders, hood, doors, quarter panels, decklid/tailgate), Bumpers
findings.evidence: Parts marked per 49 CFR 541.5(a)(1)-(18): engine, transmission, front fenders, hood, front/rear/sliding doors, front and rear bumpers, quarter panels (cars) / side assemblies (MPVs), pickup/cargo box, decklid/tailgate/hatchback. No seats, steering column, mirrors or wheels. The body text in the repo never mentions seats, steering column, mirrors or wheels.

findings.current: Body of § 541.5(a) says parts are 'specified in paragraphs (a)(1) through (a)(18)'
findings.proposed: Restore the enumerated list of 18 marked parts (and Appendix A-I exempted lines / Appendix B / C content if dropped)
findings.evidence: Repo body § 541.5(a): 'identifying number affixed or inscribed on each of the parts specified in paragraphs (a)(1) through (a)(18) inclusive' but the (a)(1)-(a)(18) list itself is absent from the file, so the 'full text' does not tell the reader which parts must be marked.

findings.proposed: (none; no UN counterpart for parts marking)
findings.evidence: UN R162 is 'Immobilisers' (repo ece-r162 title: 'UN Regulation No. 162 — Immobilisers'). Part 541 requires VIN marking on major parts to trace stolen components, not immobilizer performance.

Part 542 is purely a procedure for manufacturers and NHTSA to select new light-duty truck lines likely to have high/low theft rates (542.1(a) 'procedures ... to follow in the determination of whether any new light duty truck line is likely to have a theft rate above or below the 1990/91 median'). R116 (unauthorised use protection) and R162 (immobilisers) are technical device requirements, not equivalent.

Part 545 is a one-time manufacturer reporting/recordkeeping requirement about Part 541 phase-in (545.6: 'Within 60 days after the end of the production year ending August 31, 2007'). No UN technical counterpart.

545.4(a): 'At any time prior to August 31, 2007 ...'; 545.5 production year 'between September 1 of 2006 and August 31, 2007'. Text is still in the CFR but all reporting deadlines have passed; a certification engineer should not read it as an active obligation.

findings.current: Batteries, Electric motors, Wiring, Power electronics, Charging inlet
findings.proposed: Batteries (REESS); drop Charging inlet / Wiring / Electric motors unless justified
findings.evidence: Part 561 is documentation (rescue sheets, ERGs, low-temperature, REESS warning, thermal propagation). The only charging mentions are 'charge and discharge rates' of the REESS (561.7(c)); no requirement addresses a charging inlet or wiring.

findings.current: Battery safety, EV charging, Tell-tales & controls
findings.proposed: Battery safety, Tell-tales & controls (drop EV charging)
findings.evidence: Scope 561.1 lists ERGs/rescue sheets, low-temperature operation documentation, REESS malfunction/thermal event warning and thermal runaway documentation; nothing on charging infrastructure or charging interface.

findings.proposed: UN R100 (REESS safety) / UN GTR 20 only as partial analogue for the thermal-event/REESS documentation parts; no UN equivalent for rescue sheets/ERGs (ISO 17840)
findings.evidence: Part 561 mandates submission of ISO 17840 rescue sheets and ERGs to NHTSA (561.4, 561.6); UN R100 contains electrical-safety and REESS construction requirements, not first-responder documentation. Mapping is at best partial and should be labelled so.

findings.proposed: (none, or Tires only via weight-rating/tire information on label)
findings.evidence: Part 567 is the certification label rule. 'mirrors' appears only as an example of a readily attachable component in the 'Altered vehicle' definition; bumper appears only as a definitional reference to the bumper standard; suspension appears only in the 'incomplete vehicle' definition. None is regulated here.
Part 568 prescribes IVD/addendum/final-stage certification documentation. 'bumper' appears only in the definitions cross-reference and 'tires' only in an example GAWR line; no component requirements.

findings.current: (a)(5) GAWR example lines rendered as '(b) Front—5,215 kg ... (c) First intermediate to rear ...' at the same level as (b),(c) of the section

findings.proposed: UN R37, UN R128, UN R99 (gas-discharge light sources)
findings.evidence: Open tags include 'HID light source'; UN R99 covers gas-discharge light sources for approved lamps and is omitted, whereas Part 564 Appendix A also covers HID sources. R37/R128 are correct as partial analogues (they standardise light-source specs).
